matches.candidate_question: Will Anthropic complete an IPO by December 31, 2026?
matches.match_rationale: Market 2413330 asks whether Anthropic will IPO by December 31, 2026, which matches the hosts' question, deadline and direction exactly.

unmatched.question: Will Democrats hold at least 54 Senate seats when the new Congress convenes in January 2027?
unmatched.last_judge_rationale: No market asks whether Democrats will hold at least 54 Senate seats. The closest ones only ask about Senate control (a majority, not 54+) or combine a Democratic sweep with the US-Iran ceasefire, so none of them resolves the same question.

unmatched.question: If the Iran war ends, will Brent crude fall to around $70 per barrel by November 2027?
unmatched.last_judge_rationale: All candidates are MLB Designated Hitter award markets. The "Brent" in Brent Rooker is a name match only, so none of them concern Brent crude oil prices.
